<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/appx/manifest/foundation/windows10" xmlns:mp="http://schemas.microsoft.com/appx/2014/phone/manifest" xmlns:uap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/appx/manifest/uap/windows10" xmlns:uap3="http://schemas.microsoft.com/appx/manifest/uap/windows10/3" xmlns:xbox="http://schemas.microsoft.com/appx/manifest/xbox/windows10" IgnorableNamespaces="mp uap uap3 xbox build" xmlns:build="http://schemas.microsoft.com/developer/appx/2015/build">
  <!--
    THIS PACKAGE MANIFEST FILE IS GENERATED BY THE BUILD PROCESS.

    Changes to this file will be lost when it is regenerated. To correct errors in this file, edit the source .appxmanifest file.

    For more information on package manifest files, see http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=241727
  -->
  <!-- Version: Major.Minor.Build is the semantic version (bump manually per
       release, alongside CHANGELOG). The Revision (the trailing .0) is stamped
       automatically in CI to the workflow run number (build-uwp.ps1
       -BuildRevision) so every build is uniquely, monotonically versioned and
       the console always accepts an in-place update. Local builds keep .0. -->
  <Identity Name="GianlucaMazza.xllama" Publisher="CN=xllama-dev" Version="1.6.0.1102" ProcessorArchitecture="x64" />
  <mp:PhoneIdentity PhoneProductId="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" PhonePublisherId="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" />
  <Properties>
    <DisplayName>xllama</DisplayName>
    <PublisherDisplayName>Gianluca Mazza</PublisherDisplayName>
    <Logo>Assets\StoreLogo.png</Logo>
  </Properties>
  <Dependencies>
    <TargetDeviceFamily Name="Windows.Xbox" MinVersion="10.0.19041.0" MaxVersionTested="10.0.22621.0" />
    <TargetDeviceFamily Name="Windows.Desktop" MinVersion="10.0.19041.0" MaxVersionTested="10.0.22621.0" />
    <!-- Required by the Linux uwp-crossbuild /MD store-CRT path (VCRUNTIME140_APP).
         Device Portal installs without it and then fails launch as 0x80070002. -->
    <PackageDependency Name="Microsoft.VCLibs.140.00" MinVersion="14.0.33519.0" Publisher="CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US" />
  </Dependencies>
  <Resources>
    <Resource Language="EN-US" />
  </Resources>
  <Applications>
    <!-- EntryPoint="xllama.App": activatable class declared in App.idl, compiled by
         MIDL to xllama.winmd. AppxPackage.Targets picks up $(OutDir)xllama.winmd
         and includes it in the package payload. At runtime the OS starts xllama.exe
         whose wWinMain calls CoreApplication::Run(winrt::make<App>()). -->
    <Application Id="xllama" Executable="xllama.exe" EntryPoint="xllama.App">
      <uap:VisualElements DisplayName="xllama" Description="Local LLM inference for Xbox Series S" BackgroundColor="#0E1116" Square150x150Logo="Assets\Square150x150Logo.png" Square44x44Logo="Assets\Square44x44Logo.png">
        <uap:DefaultTile Wide310x150Logo="Assets\Wide310x150Logo.png" ShortName="xllama" />
        <uap:SplashScreen Image="Assets\SplashScreen.png" BackgroundColor="#0E1116" />
        <uap:InitialRotationPreference>
          <uap:Rotation Preference="landscape" />
        </uap:InitialRotationPreference>
      </uap:VisualElements>
    </Application>
  </Applications>
  <Capabilities>
    <Capability Name="internetClient" />
    <!-- privateNetworkClientServer is a base Capability, not a uap:Capability -->
    <Capability Name="privateNetworkClientServer" />
    <!-- removableStorage: required to enumerate KnownFolders.RemovableDevices
         for USB model loading (Exp 3 fallback path). -->
    <uap:Capability Name="removableStorage" />
    <!-- microphone: Phase 16 WS-F (card H16.6). Declared so run_mic_probe can
         find out whether GameOS grants audio capture at all — a console with no
         text input is the strongest case in the repo for speech, and the answer
         is unrecorded. Without the capability CreateDeviceInputNodeAsync
         returns AccessDenied for the manifest, which would be indistinguishable
         from the sandbox refusing, i.e. the probe would answer its own question
         wrong.

         DEV MANIFEST ONLY, deliberately. AppxManifest.store.xml declares
         internetClient and nothing else (docs/store-readiness.md), and it stays
         that way: shipping speech is a separate decision that has not been
         taken. If WS-F never ships, this line is removed with the probe. -->
    <DeviceCapability Name="microphone" />
  </Capabilities>

    <build:Item Name="VisualStudio" Version="17.0" />
    <build:Item Name="OperatingSystem" Version="10.0.20348.4647 (WinBuild.160101.0800)" />
    <build:Item Name="Microsoft.Build.AppxPackage.dll" Version="17.14.40598.3191" />

    <build:Item Name="MakePri.exe" Version="10.0.22621.5040 (WinBuild.160101.0800)" />
  </build:Metadata>
